_meta.description: TaskFleet tasks for improving World-Office test harness
_meta.notes: These tasks implement the 10 harness improvements identified in the analysis. They now target the wo-test-harness repo (moved out of this server repo Q2 2026): paths are wo-test-harness-repo-relative (tf-test-harness/, harness-graph/, conformance/). Run via run-harness-improvements.sh which resolves WO_TEST_HARNESS or a sibling checkout.
_meta.paths: repo-relative to wo-test-harness root (was scripts/tf-test-harness, scripts/harness-graph before the move)

tasks.title: Create unified test orchestrator script
tasks.acceptance_prose: Self-test passes (29 tests), --status shows task board, --help shows usage. Script uses TaskFleet libs (common.sh, status.sh, worktree.sh).

tasks.title: Generate test tasks from Rust workspace and E2E suite
tasks.acceptance_prose: generate-tests.py discovers all Rust unit tests (930+), E2E tests (100+), conformance tests (30), and creates valid JSON task definitions. --check validates all task definitions.

tasks.title: Integrate harness graph drift check into CI gate
tasks.acceptance_prose: CI workflow includes harness graph check. seed.py --check exits 0 when graph.json is current. CI fails if graph is stale.

tasks.title: Add test parallelization support
tasks.accept: TF_MAX_PARALLEL=4 timeout 120 bash tf-test-harness/test-harness.sh --category rust --max-parallel 4 --fast; time TF_MAX_PARALLEL=8 timeout 180 bash tf-test-harness/test-harness.sh --category rust --max-parallel 8 --fast
tasks.acceptance_prose: Parallel execution runs tests concurrently using TF_MAX_PARALLEL. Rust category tests complete in < 2 minutes with 8 parallel workers vs > 5 minutes with 1 worker.

tasks.title: Add coverage reporting with cargo-llvm-cov
tasks.acceptance_prose: Coverage reporting generates lcov output for Rust workspace. Cargo.toml has llvm-cov configuration. CI includes coverage reporting with >= 70% threshold.

tasks.title: Implement test impact analysis (affected tests only)
tasks.accept: python3 tf-test-harness/scripts/select-tests.py --base origin/main --list | head -20; bash tf-test-harness/test-harness.sh --affected --dry-run
tasks.acceptance_prose: select-tests.py identifies tests affected by file changes. --affected flag in test-harness.sh only runs affected tests. Dry run shows correct test selection without execution.

tasks.title: Add mutation testing with cargo-mutants
tasks.accept: cargo mutants run --package wo-common --threshold 80; bash tf-test-harness/test-harness.sh --category mut --dry-run
tasks.acceptance_prose: Mutation testing runs cargo-mutants on wo-common with >= 80% score. test-harness.sh includes mutation category. cargo-mutants is configured in Cargo.toml.

tasks.title: Add visual regression testing with pixelmatch
tasks.acceptance_prose: Visual regression captures screenshots and compares against baselines using pixelmatch. TF_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 updates baselines. Threshold comparison works with 99% similarity. Goldens stored in tests/golden/images/.

tasks.title: Build agent evaluation harness for AI-generated edits
tasks.acceptance_prose: Agent evaluation harness validates AI-generated document edits against integrity invariants. Property/fuzz/mutation suites applied to agent outputs. Mutation score for agent surface tracked. category 'agent' works in test-harness.sh.

tasks.title: Add performance and load testing infrastructure
tasks.accept: bash tf-test-harness/scripts/load-test.sh --users 10 --duration 30; cargo bench -p wo-renderer 2>/dev/null || echo 'benchmarks configured'
tasks.acceptance_prose: Load testing uses k6 to simulate users. Stress testing validates system under heavy load. criterion.rs benchmarks configured in Cargo.toml. CI includes performance CI workflow.

tasks.title: Create comprehensive HTML and JSON test reports
tasks.accept: bash tf-test-harness/test-harness.sh --category rust --fast --report-html test-report.html; test -f test-report.html; bash tf-test-harness/test-harness.sh --category rust --fast --report-json results.json; test -f results.json
tasks.acceptance_prose: HTML report is interactive with statistics, breakdowns, timeline, and failure details. JSON report is machine-readable with full task results. Markdown report works for PR comments.

tasks.title: Wire harness graph into test selection system
tasks.acceptance_prose: Tasks include feature IDs from harness graph. --feature flag selects tests by harness graph feature. Feature coverage report generated from task results.

tasks.title: Create unified CI/CD pipeline with all quality gates
tasks.acceptance_prose: CI workflow includes: harness graph check, test parallelization, coverage reporting, and test-harness integration. All gates must pass for PR merge.

tasks.title: Document complete test harness architecture and usage
tasks.accept: test -f tf-test-harness/README.md && grep -q 'Quick Start' tf-test-harness/README.md && grep -q 'Architecture' tf-test-harness/README.md
tasks.acceptance_prose: README.md includes: architecture overview, quick start, task categories, test selection options, CI integration, troubleshooting. CONTRIBUTING.md references test harness usage.

harness_graph.description: Verify harness graph is up to date
